title: the queue's pass-over
line: a person already planned with nothing left for a turn to run, whose open question is the owner's alone, is passed over and never named next; a parent with a runnable step is named; one whose only step is an assisted search with no link is passed over; one whose memorial page is on the fetch list with a link is named; a step logged none on the very fields it carries is not a turn's work, new fields name the person again, an error run is no run, a none run after it closes the step

steps.say: the home person's parents confirmed on the owner's word, so their own parents are the edge
a confirmed parent fully planned with nothing left to run, a document still undecided on him
a grandparent with an auto search step still to run, at a source with a connector
a grandparent whose only step is an assisted search with no link the fetch list prints
a grandparent whose memorial page is on the fetch list, with its link

expect.why: the grandparent with a runnable step is named; the confirmed parent with nothing left to run is passed over, his open document the reason; the grandparent with only an assisted search and no link is passed over; the one whose memorial page has a link is named

steps.say: the runnable step logged none on the very fields it carries

log.note: harness: run on these very fields

expect.why: the same query again is not a turn's work: passed over

steps.say: the plan writes new fields on it

expect.why: once the step's fields change, the person is named again

steps.say: logged error on those fields: the source did not answer, not a run

log.note: harness: the source did not answer

steps.say: logged none on them after that: the step is closed

log.note: harness: answered on the second ask

steps.say: the memorial page logged on unchanged fields: not opened again

log.note: harness: the page saved, no fit
